card.name: Period after section cross-references
card.fires_on: The sentence-ending period or closing bracket right after a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Warnings and Precautions (5.5)]. It marks the end of a label sentence just before a new section or heading begins.

modes.label: Period after cross-reference
modes.description: The full stop or closing bracket-and-period that ends a sentence after a [see Section ...] reference.

modes.description: A combined ")]." token closing a section reference, followed by the next numbered section.
